__purpose: Manager-only routing sink that executes incoming command messages on Display (prefers local bridge, falls back to server group).
label: Display

metadata.description: Routes command messages to a paired Display session without exposing UI layout details.

compatibility.rule: Accepts command sink inputs from media, image, visual, and processor nodes.
compatibility.repairHint: Connect command-producing nodes to Display when output is not visible.

examples.title: Show media on Display
examples.summary: Connect play-media cmd output to Display input to route playback commands.

risks: Can change the live Display surface immediately.
repairHints: Verify Display is paired before assuming a command failed.
